description.p: Z3-Launcher downloads prebuilt Zelda 3 game releases and generates game resources locally from a compatible ROM supplied by the user.
Configure gameplay, graphics, audio, keyboard and gamepad controls, shortcuts and the INI file in a multilingual desktop interface.
No game ROM or copyrighted Nintendo assets are included.
Development version with the forest-themed interface, five interface languages, game installation from prebuilt releases and configuration tools. Experimental Flatpak packaging added.
